description.value: Domino's is a large international pizza chain franchise on Shelbourne Street in Victoria, offering delivery and carryout pizza, cheesy bread, chicken, and desserts. It is a standard suburban chain outlet with no distinct character or cyclist-focused amenities. Touring cyclists could use it as a calorie stop, but it offers little beyond food.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: This is a standard Domino's Pizza chain franchise confirmed open at 4083 Shelbourne St, Victoria, BC; the website corroborates OSM phone, address, and URL. The website confirms takeout/carryout service and mentions veggie pizza options in the coupons listing. No evidence exists in OSM tags or website content for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities — the site is almost entirely focused on delivery/carryout ordering and promotions.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a generic national chain fast-food franchise with no evidence of cyclist-specific amenities (no bike parking, washrooms unconfirmed, no water refill info). Chain outlets of this type do not meaningfully serve WWC directory goals.
